title: install-local: measure the whole-deployment re-sync each hot install runs (123 object schemas, 33 flows per install on the showcase), and file what pays
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

Loose-ends card from #33680 / PR #33772 (merged). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.

## What was measured (PR #33772, card #33680)

On a booted showcase, each `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a small inline package (one agent, skill and tool) took 828 to 1033 ms on an idle box. Each one logged `syncSchemas() ran`, `Schema sync complete {"synced":123}` and `Re-synced 33 flow(s) after metadata reload`: the install re-syncs every object schema and every flow of the deployment, not only the installed package's items. Under merge-queue shard load that cost pushed a dogfood test over vitest's 5 s clock twice (PR #33772 moved the installs out of the test clock; the product cost stayed).

## Ask

1. Measure where the time of one hot install goes (schema sync of all objects, flow re-sync, registry rebuild, announcements), on the showcase and on a deployment with more objects, and how it scales with the deployment's size rather than the package's.
2. If a package-scoped re-sync (only the installed package's objects and flows, plus what references them) is safe, propose it with the cases it must still cover (a package that extends another's object, a flow bound to another package's object). Otherwise close with the measurement.

Dedupe words: `install-local re-sync whole deployment`, `Schema sync complete synced 123`, `Re-synced flows after metadata reload install`.
